(async()=>{ const n = await import('/js/world/nav.js'); let t0 = performance.now(); const f = n.distanceField(4,-9.5); let steps = 0, worst = 0; while (!f.done) { const s = performance.now(); f.step(3); worst = Math.max(worst, performance.now() - s); steps++; } const build = performance.now() - t0; t0 = performance.now(); let r; for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) r = n.routeFrom(f, -4, 22); const old = performance.now(); n.findPath(-4, 22, 4, -9.5, {useCache: false}); return JSON.stringify({fieldBuildMs: build.toFixed(1), slices: steps, worstSliceMs: worst.toFixed(1), routeUpdateMs: ((old-t0)/20).toFixed(2), oldSearchMs: (performance.now()-old).toFixed(1), pts: r && r.length}); })()

(async()=>{ const m = await import('/js/ui/map.js'); window.__map = m; window.__gaps = (ms) => new Promise(res => { const g = []; let last = performance.now(); const t0 = last; const f = (now) => { g.push(now - last); last = now; if (now - t0 < ms) requestAnimationFrame(f); else { g.sort((a,b)=>a-b); res(JSON.stringify({frames: g.length, p50: g[g.length>>1].toFixed(1), p95: g[Math.floor(g.length*0.95)].toFixed(1), max: g[g.length-1].toFixed(1), over40: g.filter(x=>x>40).length})); } }; requestAnimationFrame(f); }); return 1 })()
